verdict.rationale: Edge0's own docs mention 4-bit quantization, with distilled LoRA adapters that recover most of the quantization loss (gh-3). That is first-party integer quantization, but only one bit-width is evidenced. The SSD expert-offload memory savings are a different mechanism and earn no credit for this story. missing for 10: user-selectable quantization levels, very-low-bit (e.g. 2-3 bit) formats, 8-bit support, documentation of the quantization formats and their memory trade-offs, independent corroboration.
